_comment: Raw recipeCuisine value of a recipe page -> one clean German cuisine name (null = no cuisine). Used by scripts/importer/enrich_recipes.py. The pages mix languages (Deutsch, American AND Amerikanisch, Svensk, ...), so several raw values share one name. A value that is not listed here is NEVER guessed: the recipe gets no cuisine and the value is counted in the report; add it here and re-run. Keys are compared exactly (after trimming).
